<p class="hero-tagline">We study how environmental exposures and climate adaptation shape health equity in the United States and West Africa, generating evidence for more equitable energy and climate policy.</p>

<script>
(function() {
  var el = document.getElementById('reine-meaning');
  if (!el) return;
  var messages = [
    'Resilience, Energy, and Inequity in Neighborhood Environments',
    '“Reine” is also French for “queen.”'
  ];
  var i = 0;
  setInterval(function() {
    el.style.opacity = 0;
    setTimeout(function() {
      i = (i + 1) % messages.length;
      el.textContent = messages[i];
      el.style.opacity = 1;
    }, 400);
  }, 5000);
})();
</script>

### What we study

<div class="card-grid">

<div class="research-card accent-blue">
### Energy Transitions & Equity
Who benefits, and who is left behind, when households and communities shift to cleaner energy — from charcoal-to-gas to gas-to-induction.
</div>

<div class="research-card accent-orange">
### Climate, Infrastructure & Health
Power outages, extreme heat, and the health consequences of climate-strained energy infrastructure.
</div>

<div class="research-card">
### Environmental Justice Methods
Better tools for measuring environmental inequities and translating them into policy.
</div>

</div>
